items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: he played with Dow when Dow was upstairs in Small's, and I had the group downstairs.

ctx.x: Then this kid I was telling you about, the tenor player that worked with (unintelligible) me so much, Carl Stretch Ridley? He was master in '73. Then Bill Dow, very fine musician and organist -- he played with Dow when Dow was upstairs in Small's, and I had the group downstairs. He is a master this year.
Well, what proportion of the lodges consists of musicians then?
